config._case_study: VAST.AI XEON 1.5TB GENESIS - Hybrid CPU+GPU Parallel Mastery 4 Generation
config._hypothesis: 1.5TB RAM for massive populations + RTX 3060 AMP for accelerated neural training = parallel Mastery 4 emergence
config._hardware_profile_help: Vast.ai Intel Xeon Gold 6330 (88 threads) + 1548GB RAM + RTX 3060 12GB (AMP enabled)

_vast_notes.strategy: Large starting population for parallel Mastery 4 generation - GPU accelerates training, CPU RAM holds massive population
_vast_notes.value_proposition: Best of both worlds: 1.5TB RAM for population + 12GB VRAM for AMP training

language._help: Grounded Language Mode: Organisms learn language through action-outcome associations before semantic understanding
language._genesis_note: Start at level 0 - progenitors must earn vocabulary through behavioral mastery

semantic_convergence._help: Unifies 6 semantic systems for word embedding differentiation

arena._prefer_native_games_help: When true, prioritizes language/concept games that use organism's native abilities (no Gym dependency)
arena._proton_game_probability_help: Fraction of battles that use Proton Game Arena (0.0-1.0). Set to 0.5 for 50% Proton Game battles.

trap_mechanics._help: Planning pressure via trap logic in battles

arena.description: Proton Game Arena - Apprentice Adept style gym battles (Piers Anthony + Highlander inspired)

evolution._adaptation_sensitivity_help: Lower sensitivity - large population absorbs fluctuations better

diversity_guard._frequency_threshold_help: Lower threshold - large population has natural diversity
diversity_guard._penalty_help: Lighter penalty - diversity emerges from large population naturally

evolution._max_generations_help: Long runs for parallel mastery evolution

mutation_rate._initial_help: Moderate mutation - 2000 founders already have diversity

evolution._population_size_help: PARALLEL MASTERY: 2000 starting organisms = many parallel paths to Mastery 4

mutation_rate._max_help: Wide range for boom/bust - can spike during bottlenecks

hardware_governor._auto_scale_help: Set to false to disable auto-scaling of config values. Governor will only clamp to max, not scale up.

health_monitor._critical_threshold_help: Lower threshold - genesis populations are volatile
health_monitor._weight_adaptability_help: Higher weight on adaptability for genesis - need to adapt fast
health_monitor._weight_diversity_help: Highest weight - diversity critical with 5 founders

highlander._eval_interval_seconds_help: BOOM-BUST WAVES: 20-minute growth periods between Highlander concentration waves. Mastery 4+ organisms only.

alliance_warfare._max_alliance_size_help: Large alliances for political mega-structures (75% of 2TB)
alliance_warfare._war_frequency_help: Lower war frequency during boom phase, increases as population grows

organism_communication._help: Organisms speak at confluence points - language is the allspice that connectifies everything
organism_communication._ultimatum_help: Join or Die - powerful warchiefs can demand submission

boom_bust_dynamics._seasonal_amplitude_help: Strong seasonal swings for dramatic boom/bust

lineage_tracking._founder_bonus_help: Bonus for founding lineages - 5 original bloodlines
lineage_tracking._max_lineage_depth_help: Deep lineage tracking for epic family trees

highlander._competition_intensity_help: Low initial intensity - let population boom first

extreme_mode._competition_intensity_help: Extreme mode kicks in during bust - 50% battle
extreme_mode._min_population_help: Can drop to just 3 survivors during extinction
extreme_mode._mutation_rate_help: Maximum mutation during extinction for rapid adaptation

highlander._germination_rate_help: Moderate germination - 2000 start already provides density for parallel mastery paths
highlander._min_population_help: Keep minimum high to maintain parallel mastery paths
highlander._population_size_help: PARALLEL MASTERY: 2000 starting organisms = many simultaneous paths to Mastery 4
highlander._survival_threshold_help: Low threshold during boom - let population grow

logging._shared_state_dump_interval_help: Less frequent dumps - long running genesis
logging._sample_rate_help: Log 1 in 10 - save disk space on long runs

meta_cognitive.description: Meta-cognitive systems: self-awareness, self-tuning, autonomous optimization

self_tuning._min_confidence_threshold_help: Lower confidence threshold for genesis volatility

performance_targets._max_anomaly_ratio_help: Higher tolerance for anomalies during boom/bust

network._max_connections_help: 2M connections for massive political networks (75% of 2TB)
network._resource_pool_help: Resource pool scaled for 40K max population

hopfield._help: Modern continuous Hopfield network for iterative thought refinement

world_model._help: Predictive world model for imagination-based planning

neural._device_help: CUDA mode - RTX 3060 for accelerated training, experience buffers stay in 1.5TB CPU RAM.

inheritance._mutation_rate_help: Higher neural mutation for genesis diversity

knowledge_web._max_concepts_help: Large concept space for emergent language (75% of 2TB)

quality_control._exploration_start_help: High initial exploration for genesis founders

staged_knowledge._help: Delay loading expanded knowledge web to let organisms build foundations with innate vocab first

training._entropy_bonus_help: Higher entropy for creative genesis exploration

amp._enabled_help: AMP enabled - RTX 3060 Ampere architecture supports BF16/FP16 tensor cores
amp._dtype_help: FP16 for RTX 3060 (Ampere but older than 40-series). Use 'bfloat16' for 40-series.
amp.description: Mixed precision training - 2-3x GPU speedup on RTX 3060 tensor cores

optimization._use_compile_help: torch.compile enabled for CUDA - reduces kernel launch overhead
optimization._use_scripted_inference_help: TorchScript for faster inference on GPU

rewards._fitness_improvement_help: Higher reward for fitness - drive evolution
rewards._survival_help: Higher survival reward - genesis is dangerous

training._batch_size_help: RTX 3060 12GB VRAM + AMP = can handle larger batches (2x with FP16)

checkpointing._help: Auto-save training state to prevent data loss. Checkpoint every N generations or minutes.

ray._batch_inference_size_help: Larger batch inference with GPU acceleration
ray.description: Ray DISABLED - can enable if metrics agent spam fixed
ray._parallelization_threshold_help: Higher threshold for genesis massive populations
ray._training_threshold_help: Higher training threshold for batching efficiency

anomaly_detection._contamination_help: Higher contamination - genesis has more outliers

simulation._max_runtime_help: 24 hours max - designed for long genesis runs
simulation._save_interval_help: Less frequent saves for long runs
simulation._target_fps_help: 0 = unlimited speed, >0 = rate limit to N cycles/sec

stabilization._max_jump_help: Higher max jump tolerance for genesis volatility
